decisions.briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.1% and the S&P 500 down 1.1%, triggering a risk-off screen with no qualifying candidates. We're holding all 7 existing positions unchanged and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit technology and growth names hardest today, pulling the NASDAQ down more than double the S&P 500's decline, a pattern typical of risk-off days when investors rotate out of higher-beta assets. Without specific news headlines available for today, the move appears driven by general market risk-aversion rather than a single catalyst. In risk-off conditions like this, the screener correctly returned no new candidates, reinforcing the discipline to wait rather than chase.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場廣泛拋售,科技股及增長股受創最深,帶動納斯達克指數跌幅超過標普500指數的兩倍,這是典型的避險日模式,投資者從高波動資產中撤出。由於今日未有具體新聞頭條可供參考,此次下跌似乎是由整體市場避險情緒驅動,而非單一事件觸發。在這種避險環境下,篩選系統正確地未篩出任何新候選股,這印證了按兵不動、等待時機的紀律。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech, often moving into cash or safer assets instead. On days like this, disciplined investors avoid forcing new trades and instead protect existing gains by holding steady and letting stop-losses and profit targets do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(Risk-Off) 是指投資者普遍拋售風險較高的資產,例如增長股和科技股,轉而持有現金或更安全的資產。在這種日子裡,有紀律的投資者會避免強行進行新交易,而是透過按兵不動來保護現有收益,讓止損和獲利目標機制自動發揮作用。
